csv_project_name: Civil Design for 39th Street Sidewalk Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: City of Washougal is soliciting qualification statements from consultants to select a design consultant for professional services on the 39TH Street Sidewalk Project. he 39th Street corridor currently experiences high vehicle speeds and lacks continuous pedestrian facilities, creating safety concerns for residents and students walking or biking to nearby schools. The project will address these issues by constructing approximately 2,200 linear feet of new sidewalk, upgrading ADA curb ramps, installing high-visibility crosswalks, Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFBs), speed feedback signs, and speed cushions, as well as adding pedestrian-scale lighting and buffered bike lanes.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
